title: Mueller Corp. $4.9M Budget OK'd
meeting_type: Mueller Local Government Corporation (MLGC) Board of Directors Regular Meeting
summary:

*   The approved budget totals nearly $5 million ($4,978,965) for the corporation's operations.
*   All agenda items, including the budget approval, passed unanimously and quickly as part of a consent agenda, with no public speakers.
